name: SCQA Framework
id_mapping: ENGINEERING_ADAPTATION: FW numeric correspondence to AG; source explicitly illustrates FW-11

source_original.purpose: Pembingkaian konteks masalah secara tajam (*Situation, Complication, Question, Answer*)
source_original.inputs: Deskripsi masalah mentah dan metrik perubahan kondisi bisnis
source_original.outputs: Narasi terstruktur 4 bagian SCQA untuk menyelaraskan pemahaman pemangku kepentingan

activation_conditions: User requests SCQA Framework or the orchestrator justifies it against the problem.
methodology: Identify the Complication and its consequences
Give a provisional Answer with assumptions and evidence gaps
Do not smuggle a root-cause conclusion into framing
tool_requirements: Host reasoning and resource reading; calculation tool when required.
evidence_requirements: Cite material claims; mark missing inputs UNKNOWN; do not reuse illustrative source conclusions.
limitations: Host-authored analysis requires behavioral evaluation; schema validity does not prove truth.
validation_criteria: Provide situation or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide complication or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide question or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide answer or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Use all distinctive methodology steps and identify missing evidence.
